title: Alien bases as government-granted 'reservations'

tellings.quote: that um these are the places where our government or the governments of other countries have said you can have this spot to have your base. You stay away from us and we'll stay away from you.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who worked in a military psychic spying unit, says that alien bases are places that the US government and other governments have handed over to the visitors, a bit like reservations. He describes the deal as: you can have this spot for your base, you stay away from us and we'll stay away from you, which, if true, would mean governments have a standing agreement with non-human beings.
